answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 6 graders each stake 57 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. What carries the pigment here is verification, the zephyr of cost is what stops the farm, and the vertex of the record keeps every claim checkable.
